title: Quantum determinants in polynomial time
summary: We give an algebraic branching program of polynomial size which computes Cayley determinant of right quantum matrices. This is a rare example of an efficient computation of a noncommutative determinant, and the first such example for quantum groups. We extend the results to the $q$-Cayley determinant of $q$-right quantum matrices, as well as to their multiparameter generalization. The proofs are entirely combinatorial, as we relate Cayley, Moore and Valiant determinants using bijections/involutions on words.
